references.text: The same description of the fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and the kidneys with the fat on them - used in the peace offering.
Parallel text regarding the offering of the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver in connection with the thank offering.
The fulfillment of Exodus 29:22 - Moses performs the consecration offering with the fat, the fat tail, the kidneys, the lobe of the liver, and the right thigh.
A similar sacrificial act involving the pieces of fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the bull and the ram.
The continuation of the text concerning the breast and the thigh from the ram of consecration as a holy portion.
The right thigh shall be given to the priest as his share, parallel to the right thigh of the consecration offering.
The right thigh and the breast belong to the priests as their portion of the sacrifice.
This is the actual execution of the ordination ritual that was commanded in Exodus 29.
Describes the very action during the ordination ritual given in Exodus 29.
A complementary description of the same ritual act (burning) in the same chapter.
